settings.windowsfixes.title: Windows Fixes
settings.windowsfixes.npsm_desc: When this fix is enabled, it will attempt to resolve the Windows Media Control issue introduced in build 10.0.26100, which can cause media controls to completely break. This also fixes an issue where pressing Fn + F5, Fn + F6 or Fn + F7 could cause Windows Explorer to crash. Furthermore, this fixes issues where the OSC Custom Chatbox and VR Overlay may not show the current song information correctly. It checks roughly every 10 minutes and safely restarts the hung service if needed.
settings.debug.title: Debugging
settings.debug.desc: Use these options if something isn't working correctly or you want to reconfigure VRCNext from scratch.
settings.debug.memory_trim_desc: Memory Trim periodically frees unused memory from VRCNext. While the app already cleans up automatically during normal use, enabling this triggers a more frequent garbage collection pass every 15 minutes.
settings.debug.text_tools.label: Enable Text Tools
settings.debug.text_tools.desc: When enabled, all text in VRCNext becomes selectable. You can copy it via the right-click context menu or with Ctrl + C.
settings.image_cache.title: Image Cache
settings.image_cache.desc: VRCNext caches avatar, world, and profile images locally for instant loading. Over time this can grow to several gigabytes. Set a limit and the oldest cached images will be removed automatically when it is reached (~2 GB per cleanup pass).
settings.image_cache.limit_hint: When the limit is reached, the oldest ~2 GB of cached images are removed automatically.
settings.image_cache.optimize.label: Optimize Caching
settings.image_cache.optimize.desc: PNG images > 1.5 MB are compressed to JPEG automatically
settings.image_cache.mem_optimize.label: Optimize Memory Usage
settings.image_cache.mem_optimize.desc: Use lower resolution thumb images to save up memory usage
settings.ffc.title: Fast Fetch Cache
settings.ffc.desc: Fast Fetch Cache stores user profiles, worlds, groups, and avatars locally to improve load times. When enabled, VRCNext instantly shows cached content (descriptions, texts, images) while silently refreshing it in the background. When disabled, all data is freshly downloaded on every request with no cache stored or used.
settings.db.title: Database Settings
settings.db.desc: Limits how many timeline entries are loaded into memory at startup. Keeps the Timeline fast with large databases. A restart is required to apply changes.
settings.db.entries_desc: Min: 500, Max: 250,000. Loads the N most recent entries for Personal and Friends separately.
settings.db.optimize_off_warning: Warning: Optimize Database is disabled. All entries will be loaded on startup. This may significantly impact performance with large databases.
settings.db.cleanup.danger: Danger Zone! This Database Optimization will delete certain things from the database.
settings.db.warn.title: What gets deleted, and what stays
settings.db.warn.friends_body: Status changes, status texts, online and offline states, bio changes and avatar changes get trimmed. The most recent entries always remain (the last 1000 online and offline states, the last 200 status texts and bio changes, the last 100 status changes and avatar changes). Only the older, bloated history is removed.
settings.db.warn.personal_body: Notifications, video URLs and avatar switches get trimmed to the last 100 each. The player lists of past instances are also trimmed, the players are kept only for your most recent 100 instances.
settings.db.warn.users_body: Cached data of non friended users is cleared (Time Spent and Meet Counts stay). Bio links of all profiles are cleared. All of this is re-fetched from VRChat when needed.
settings.db.warn.note: So not everything is gone, only the bloated data that is not really needed. The database is then compacted to free up disk space. If you still want to keep the old entries, create a backup before running optimization.
settings.db.cleanup.user_cache: It will delete all cached non-friended users from the whole database. This is mostly safe as it does not contain any important information. Time Spent and Meet Counts are still present on those profiles and will not be wiped.
settings.db.cleanup.events: It will also delete certain events in your Personal and Friends Timeline. In the Personal Timeline, all notifications and URL entries will be wiped. In the Friends Timeline, all "Online", "Offline", and "Status Change" entries, for example "Ask Me" > "Join Me", will be wiped.
settings.db.cleanup.instructions: Run the analysis first. After that, you will see what will be wiped. It is recommended to create a backup of your database in case you still need those entries. Your database is usually stored at:
settings.avtrdb.title: Avatar Avtrdb and Avtr.icu Community Support
settings.avtrdb.support.deleted_desc: Help improve the avatar databases by reporting deleted avatars. When enabled, VRCNext will notify the respective database whenever you encounter a deleted or DMCA'd avatar, but only if that avatar exists in that database.
settings.avtrdb.support.submit_desc: Submit new public avatars you encounter in-game to the avatar databases. When you switch to an avatar that isn't indexed yet, VRCNext will automatically submit it. This helps expand the databases and makes more avatars discoverable for everyone.
settings.avtrdb.reports.desc: All reports sent to avatar databases during this session. Avtrdb reports include a ticket link to check status.
settings.avtrdb.reports.empty: No reports sent yet this session.
settings.vrcndb.title: VRCNDb Community Database
settings.vrcndb.submit_desc: Submit avatar IDs you encounter in-game to the official VRCNDb database (db.vrcnext.com). Only the ID is sent. The server verifies the avatar itself, stores only public avatars, and downloads the image on its own. This helps build the community avatar search. IDs are collected live from the VRChat log, including avatars blocked by your performance settings, and from the VRChat cache.
settings.vrcndb.synclikes_desc: When enabled, your favorited avatars count as a "like" on VRCNDb. This is completely anonymous and is an opt-out setting. It simply helps show which avatars are trendy. Syncs on every start and whenever you add a new favorite.
settings.vrcndb.syncwears_desc: When enabled, wearing an avatar counts toward its "wear" count on VRCNDb. This is completely anonymous and is an opt-out setting. It helps show which avatars are actually worn and trending.
settings.vrcndb.deleted_desc: Report avatars that appear to be deleted so VRCNDb re-verifies them. An avatar is only removed from the database if VRChat itself confirms it no longer exists.
settings.vrcndb.reports.desc: Avatar IDs submitted to VRCNDb during this session.
settings.vrcndb.reports.empty: No submissions sent yet this session.
settings.vrcndb.consent.title: Support the VRCNDb Community Database
settings.vrcndb.consent.body: When you join instances, VRCNext collects the avatar IDs of public avatars around you and submits them to the VRCNDb community database (db.vrcnext.com). Only the ID is sent, the server verifies each avatar itself, stores only public avatars and downloads the image on its own. This builds the community avatar search.

settings.vrcndb.consent.comments_desc: Show comments in world modals. If you do not want to see user comments, disable this.

vro.attachment.seamless_desc: When enabled, instead of using SteamVR control API it uses VRCNexts own pointer API which allows to control the overlay with your controllers without being blocked by steams api. This is good when using the overlay in VRChat without losing any controls over the game input. Picking/Clicking/Scrolling things uses the Trigger button on either your left or right controller depending on which side the overlay is on your wrist.
vro.transform.title: Transform
vro.visibility.title: Overlay Visibility
vro.visibility.desc: When enabled, the overlay fades out while it is away from your headset and becomes fully visible and clickable once you move it close to your face. While faded it stays slightly visible but cannot be clicked, so you can keep it open all the time without accidental clicks.
vro.keybind.title: Toggle Keybind
vro.keybind.toggle_view: Switch between controller and list view
vro.keybind.hint.record_double_tap: Press one button and hold to record for Double Tap...
vro.keybind.hint.record_combo: Hold 1-4 buttons simultaneously to record a combo...
vro.keybind.hint.manual_edit: Click the buttons above to select your keybind. Double Tap mode allows 1 button only.
vro.keybind.hand.label: Hand:
vro.keybind.hint.idle_double_tap: Double-tap a single button to toggle the overlay.
vro.keybind.hint.idle_combo: Hold 1-4 buttons on one controller to toggle the overlay.
settings.launch.auto_start_windows_desc: VRCNext launches automatically when Windows starts. It will appear in the system tray.
settings.system.hide_in_tray_desc: When closing VRCNext, it minimizes to the system tray instead of exiting. Click the tray icon to restore the window.
settings.system.tray.title: System Tray
settings.system.tray.notifications_desc: Displays a notification when a new VRChat notification arrives while VRCNext is hidden in the system tray.
settings.language.restart_hint: It is recommended to restart the app once you change the language.
settings.crash.title: Crash Reporting
settings.crash.label: Send anonymous crash reports
settings.crash.desc: If VRCNext crashes and this is enabled, the crash report is sent automatically. If disabled, you will be asked manually on next startup.
settings.crash.restart_after_crash_desc: VRCNext will automatically restart after an unexpected crash. Does not apply when the app is closed normally or force-quit via Task Manager.
settings.perf.title: Performance
settings.perf.gpu_accel.label: Enable Hardware Acceleration
settings.perf.gpu_accel.desc: Enables GPU hardware acceleration for the WebView2 renderer. May improve rendering performance but can cause visual glitches on some systems.
settings.perf.shader_cache.label: Enable GPU Shader Cache
settings.perf.shader_cache.desc: Caches compiled GPU shaders to disk. Reduces GPU startup overhead on subsequent launches.
settings.perf.v8_heap.label: Use 128 MB V8 Heap
settings.perf.v8_heap.desc: Increases the JavaScript engine memory limit from 64 MB to 128 MB. Useful if VRCNext runs sluggishly with large friend lists or many open tabs.
settings.perf.render_proc.label: Use 2 Render Processes
settings.perf.render_proc.desc: Allows WebView2 to use up to 2 renderer processes instead of 1. Can help with stability but uses slightly more memory.
settings.perf.restart_hint: A restart is required to apply performance changes.
settings.perf.animations.label: Animations and Transitions
settings.perf.animations.desc: Disables all animations and transitions in VRCNext. This can speed up opening dialogs and switching between them, and may also save a little bit of CPU costs.
settings.perf.blur.label: Blur Filters
settings.perf.blur.desc: Disables blur filters on modals and overlays. Instead of a blurred background, a dark overlay (75%) is shown. Especially useful when GPU acceleration is disabled, as blur effects are CPU-intensive. It is recommended to disable Blur Filters when using the app without GPU acceleration.
settings.perf.efficiency.label: Efficiency Mode
settings.perf.efficiency.desc: Runs the VRCNext process and its WebView processes in Windows Efficiency Mode (EcoQoS). Lowers power usage and background CPU impact; the leaf icon appears in Task Manager. May slightly reduce responsiveness. Applies immediately, no restart needed.
settings.search_debounce.title: Performance
settings.search_debounce.label: Search Index Debounce Speed
settings.search_debounce.desc: Search Index Debounce determines how many milliseconds it takes until it starts searching the database or certain entries after your last key press. Default is 500ms which works fine for almost every user. If you have more than 1000 Friends, 500ms is perfect. If you have more than 2500 Friends, it is recommended to use 750ms.
settings.search_debounce.warning: Do not change this to a value below 500ms, especially when you have a large friends list, many groups, many saved avatars and worlds!
settings.experimental.multitask.label: Multi-Task Mode
settings.experimental.multitask.desc: When enabled you can open up to 12 Group, Profile, Event, World, Avatar or Instance modals at the same time. Press SHIFT + Left Mouse on anything that opens a modal to open it in Multi-Task mode. You can drag a window by its title bar, resize it at the corners and minimize it into the dock at the bottom. It is recommended to only use this while the app is maximized, since navigating gets very hard in a small window.
settings.experimental.multitask.warning: This is an experimental feature, expect bugs.
settings.safety.comments_desc: When enabled, you can write comments on worlds and see comments from other players. Keep in mind this is not fully moderated. Bad words and slurs are blocked by our filter, but people can still find ways to be unkind. If you would rather not see comments at all, turn this feature off.
settings.friends.title: Friends And User Settings
settings.friends.always_stats_desc: When enabled, every person in the People tab always shows a bar with how much time you spent with them and how many meets you have, instead of clicking the "Stats" button. While this is on, the Stats button is hidden because it is always active.
settings.sidebar.title: Friends Sidebar
settings.sidebar.location_only_desc: When enabled, friends who are in a world show the instance's region flag and world name instead of their status. Friends who aren't in a world keep showing their status text.
settings.sidebar.preview_collapsed_desc: Shows a friend's profile as a small preview when you hover over them while the friends sidebar is collapsed.
settings.sidebar.preview_open: Show Preview Profile when sidebar is open
settings.sidebar.preview_open_desc: Shows the profile preview even when the sidebar is open. You have to hover over the profile image for at least 1.5 seconds; it will not appear when hovering any other part of the friend entry.
settings.sidebar.separate_favorites_desc: When enabled you can switch between Friends, Favorites and Groups. If this setting is disabled you will only see Friends and Groups, and your favorite friends stay inside the normal Friends tab as usual.
settings.navsidebar.title: Navigation Sidebar
settings.navsidebar.hover_text: Show Hover Text on Collapsed Navigation
settings.navsidebar.hover_text_desc: When enabled, the navigation sidebar shows a hover text when collapsed. This makes it easier to navigate and is especially useful when you want to know which menu entry you are hovering over.
settings.navsidebar.modern_folders_desc: When enabled, clicking a folder (like "Tools" or your own custom folders) opens a compact pop-out grid right next to the sidebar instead of expanding a long list of items inline so you don't have to scroll through the whole sidebar. Turn this off to use the classic layout where folder items expand directly inside the sidebar.
settings.update.title: Update VRCNext
settings.update.auto_update_desc: Automatically download and install updates on startup.
settings.info.title: Copyright And Information
settings.info.p1: VRCNext is a VRChat assistant application that brings together tools and ideas from different applications into one unified app. It is designed for managing friends, groups, worlds, and analytics, and also provides communication features and a toolbox to make everything easier in a single place.
settings.info.p2: VRCNext is not endorsed by VRChat and does not reflect the views or opinions of the VRChat staff or anyone officially involved in the development or management of VRChat. VRChat is a registered trademark of VRChat Inc.
settings.info.p3: Shinyflvres and all contributors are not responsible for any issues that may be caused by VRCNext. In general, VRCNext is not a problem for VRChat, but misuse such as abusing features, exploiting others, or generating excessive request spam may result in moderation by VRChat.
settings.info.p4: Your User ID and the VRCNext Client ID are used to communicate with the VRChat API. Use VRCNext respectfully and do not attempt to exploit, manipulate, or generate spam requests, as this may lead to moderation.
permini.title: Permini
permini.desc: Friends on this list will automatically receive an invite to your current instance when they send an invite request.
permini.desc2: For Invite-Only instances, this only works if they are the instance owner. For all other instance types, they can invite you.
permini.important.title: Important
permini.important.text: Do Not Disturb invite requests only work when using VRCNext or VRCX. Invite requests cannot be sent through VRChat or the website in this case, because they are blocked there. So if your friend wants to join you while your status is set to Do Not Disturb, they must use VRCNext or VRCX.
permini.toggle.active_title: Auto-invite when status is Active / Online
permini.toggle.askme_title: Auto-invite when status is Ask Me
permini.advanced.title: Advanced
permini.advanced.only_between: Only accept during a time window
permini.toggle.dnd_title: Auto-invite when status is Do Not Disturb
permini.picker.title: Add Friend to Permini
setup.page1.title: Choose Your Language
setup.page1.desc: Select your preferred language for VRCNext. You can change this at any time in Settings.
setup.page2.title: Welcome to VRCNext
setup.page2.desc: VRCNext is your VRChat companion app with powerful tools and features to enhance your experience. In this Setup Wizard we'll walk you through the important steps. It is recommended not to skip!
setup.page2.step1_desc: Connect your account to unlock all features
setup.page2.step2_desc: Set your VRChat installation path for quick launching
setup.page2.step3_desc: Point VRCNext to your VRChat screenshot folder
setup.page2.step4_desc: Enable metadata for photo world tracking
setup.page3.title: Login to VRChat
setup.page3.desc_html: First, you need to log in to VRChat in order to use all features of this app. Without logging in, you'll miss out on almost 90% of the functionality. This step is optional, you can skip it if you prefer.
setup.page4.title: VRChat Launch Location
setup.page4.desc_html: Please locate the launch.exe in your VRChat root folder. This is usually found in your Steam library folder. If you can't find it, right-click VRChat in Steam → Properties → Installed Files → Browse.
setup.page5.title: VRChat Image Library
setup.page5.desc: Point VRCNext to your VRChat screenshot folder so the app can monitor new photos, show them in your media library, and track which worlds they were taken in.
setup.page6.title: Camera Settings
setup.page6.desc_html: Make sure to enable Metadata in your VRChat camera settings. This allows VRCNext to track which world each photo was taken in, so you can easily find that world again, even months later!
setup.page6.step1: Open the Camera in VRChat via the quick menu
setup.page6.step3: Enable “Save Metadata to Photo” which embeds world info into each screenshot
setup.page6.step4: Done! VRCNext will automatically read this data and show the world on your photos
setup.page7.title: Start with Windows
setup.page7.desc: Should VRCNext launch automatically when Windows starts? It will open minimized in the taskbar so it is ready when you need it.
setup.page2.step5_desc: Show icon frames, name plates, backgrounds and themes
setup.page2.step6_desc: Choose what you see next to each of your friends
setup.page2.step7_desc: Peek at a friend's profile without opening it
setup.page2.step8_desc: Pick the classic or the compact modal layout
setup.page2.step9_desc: Move the history and actions into the modal itself
setup.page2.step10_desc: Launch VRCNext automatically when your system boots
setup.page7.desc_linux: Should VRCNext launch automatically when Linux starts? It will open minimized so it is ready when you need it.
setup.page2.step10_desc_linux: Launch VRCNext automatically when Linux boots
setup.vrcplus.title: VRChat Plus Decorations
setup.vrcplus.desc: VRChat Plus users can decorate their profile with icon frames, name plates, backgrounds and themes. VRCNext can show all of that inside the app.
setup.vrcplus.question: Do you want to use the new VRChat Plus profile decorations?
setup.vrcplus.toggle_sub: Turns on the recommended set of decoration options
setup.vrcplus.note: You can fine-tune every single one of these later in Settings → VRC+ Decorations.
setup.sidebar.title: Friends Sidebar
setup.sidebar.desc: The friends sidebar lists everyone you are friends with. Choose how much you want to see at a glance.
setup.sidebar.location_question: Do you want to see the location or the status?
setup.sidebar.location_toggle_sub: Friends in a world show the world name, everyone else keeps their status.
setup.preview.title: Preview Profiles
setup.preview.desc: When the friends sidebar is collapsed you only see the profile pictures. A preview shows you who that is without opening the full profile.
setup.preview.question: Do you want to see a profile preview of your friend when the sidebar is collapsed?
setup.preview.toggle_sub: Hovering a friend opens a small profile card next to the sidebar.
setup.tfa.title: Two-Factor Authentication
setup.tfa.msg_totp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
setup.tfa.msg_email: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your email.
crash.modal.title: VRCNext has crashed
crash.modal.msg:
Would you like to send the crash report to the developers to help them fix the issue?

The crash log is anonymous and only contains the stack trace of the crash. It does not include any personal information or user data.
kikitan.settings.title: Settings
kikitan.personality.title: Personality
kikitan.personality.hint: Kawai appends one mood-matching kaomoji at the end of every translated sentence. Affects only speech translation — not profile, world or group description translations.
kikitan.profile_translation.title: Profile Translation
kikitan.profile_translation.hint: When Profile Translation is enabled you will see a "Translate" icon in the Biography section. Clicking this will translate it to your target language.
profiles.bio.translate_no_key: Set your Groq API key in Kikitan XD first.
kikitan.partial_osc: Live typing (Gemini Live, Local LLM only)
kikitan.partial_osc_desc: Shows the sentence building up in the chatbox while you speak, instead of only the finished result. Only active when translation is off, because sending partial text would use up the chatbox rate limit the finished translation needs.
kikitan.chatbox_notify_desc: When enabled the chatbox will make a blop sound after the final message has been sent.
kikitan.recognized.title: Recognized Speech
kikitan.translation.title: Translation
kikitan.non_speech_desc: When enabled then things like "(laughs)" "(coughing)" will not be shown in your textbox.
kikitan.silero_desc: Runs the Silero voice activity model over every recording segment before it reaches Whisper. Segments without speech are dropped and silence at the start and end is cut away, so breathing, clicks and background noise are not transcribed. Needs the Silero VAD download under Local Models.
kikitan.api_key.hint: Kikitan XD requires a free Groq API key for Speech-To-Text and live translation. Sign up with Google, GitHub, SSO or email at console.groq.com/keys, create a new API key, and paste it above.
kikitan.google_api_key.hint: The Google Gemini Live model needs a free Google AI Studio API key for live speech translation. Sign in with your Google account at aistudio.google.com/apikey, create an API key, and paste it above. The free tier is enough for personal use.
kikitan.model.title: Model
kikitan.local.hint: Everything runs on your own machine, no API key and no rate limits. Download a recognition model and a translation model below, plus the matching runtime. Large models need a lot of VRAM, which VRChat also uses in VR.
kikitan.local.use_gpu_desc: Runs both models on the graphics card via Vulkan, which works with your normal display driver. Requires the two GPU runtimes below. Turn this off to use the processor instead, which is far slower.
kikitan.local.vulkan_missing: No Vulkan driver found on this PC. Update your graphics driver, or use the CPU runtime.
kikitan.model.hint: Groq uses Whisper for transcription plus a separate translation step. Google Gemini Live translates speech directly in one streaming model and auto-detects the source language.
kikitan.blocked.title: Blocked Words and Sentences
kikitan.blocked.hint: Words are stripped from recognition wherever they appear. Sentences are only blocked when the whole recognized text matches exactly, so similar phrases still go through.
kikitan.blocked.word_placeholder: Type a word and press Enter...
kikitan.blocked.sentence_placeholder: Type a sentence and press Enter...

as.speed.desc: Low value = fast, high value = smooth (slow)
vro.scale.title: Avatar Scaler
vro.scale.desc: Adds a Size tab to the VR overlay. Hold a keybind and move the thumbstick to scale your avatar.
vro.scale.thumbstick.title: Thumbstick
vro.scale.keybind.title: Hold Keybind to Scale
vro.scale.keybind.desc: Hold these buttons while moving the thumbstick to scale your avatar in VR.
vro.scale.hint.record: Hold 1–4 buttons simultaneously to record a combo…
vro.scale.hint.idle: Hold keybind + move thumbstick up/down to scale.

relay.folders.title: Watch Folders
relay.folders.desc: Choose which watch folders the relay monitors for new images and videos.
relay.folders.empty: No watch folders configured. Add folders in Settings.
page.help.0: Your main hub. See your current VRChat status, online friends, friend activity, world news, and your favorite worlds and avatars. Connect to VRChat to see live data. Scroll down to explore all sections.
page.help.1: Browse worlds in VRChat. Switch between Favorites, My Worlds, and Search. Click any world card to open its details or join an instance.
page.help.2: Browse and manage your VRChat groups. View your joined groups, explore group announcements and posts, and search for new groups to join.
page.help.3: Search for any VRChat user by name or ID. Click a profile to view their details, send friend requests, check shared instances, or manage your relationship with them.
page.help.4: Manage your VRChat avatar library. Browse your own uploaded avatars and your favorited ones. Click any avatar to see its details or switch to it in-game.
page.help.5: Send custom text messages to your VRChat in-game chatbox. Type a message and it appears above your avatar. Supports quick messages and TTS triggers. Make sure OSC is enabled in VRChat settings under Options → OSC.
page.help.6:
Automatically forwards screenshots taken in VRChat to a Discord channel using a webhook.

Setup:
1. Open your Discord server and go to the channel you want.
2. Click the gear icon (Edit Channel) → Integrations → Webhooks.
3. Click "New Webhook", give it a name, then copy the webhook URL.
4. Paste the URL into the Webhook field here and press Start.

All new screenshots from VRChat will now be sent to that channel automatically.
page.help.7: Browse all screenshots and images captured in VRChat. Images are shown in a gallery grid and can be filtered or sorted by date and world. Click any image to open it in full view.
page.help.8: A live logger of all REST API requests VRCNext makes to the VRChat API. Shows each request with its HTTP status code (200, 429, 404, 403, 400), CDN call counts, API request rates, and WebSocket connection state. Use the console input at the bottom to run commands.
page.help.9: Configure VRCNext to your preferences. Change the accent color, theme, language, zoom level, startup tab, and many other options. Some settings require a restart to take effect.
page.help.10:
Lets you physically drag your SteamVR playspace while in VR. Hold the configured controller button and move your arm to shift your position up, down, or sideways.

Requires SteamVR to be running. Configure which hands and buttons trigger the drag, lock individual axes, and adjust the drag speed multiplier.
page.help.11:
Send and receive raw OSC messages to and from VRChat. Useful for testing custom OSC setups, debugging automations, or building integrations.

Requirement: OSC must be enabled in VRChat under Options → OSC.
page.help.12: A visual timeline of your entire VRChat history. Browse events like world visits, friend interactions, and avatar changes over time. Use the date filters to jump to a specific period.
page.help.13: Browse the items in your VRChat inventory such as prints and collectibles. Some items may require an active VRC+ subscription to access or use.
page.help.14:
Fixes YouTube video playback errors that occur in VRChat worlds by routing video requests through a local proxy server.

Setup:
1. Click "Install / Update" to install the patcher.
2. Create a throwaway YouTube account and log into it in Chrome or Firefox.
3. Install the browser extension using the button below.
4. Start the YouTube Fix service here.
5. Refresh the YouTube page until it shows "Valid Cookies".

Leave the service running whenever you play VRChat.
page.help.15: Visualizes your social network in VRChat. Shows mutual friends, how players are connected to each other, and clusters of shared friendships. Click any node to explore connections.
page.help.16: Tracks how much time you have spent in VRChat, broken down by world, session, and time period. Data is pulled from your local activity log. Use filters to explore different timeframes.
page.help.17: Browse the official VRChat event calendar. Filter between Featured, Following, and All events. Click any event to see its description, time, and world location.
page.help.18:
A voice-triggered soundboard powered by local speech recognition (VOSK). Assign sound files to trigger words and say the word out loud to play the sound through your selected audio output.

To set it up: add a trigger word, attach one or more sound files to it, then click Start. Recognized speech is shown in real time at the bottom of the screen.
page.help.19: Shows your current VRChat world and instance as your Discord Rich Presence status. Privacy settings in VRCNext control how much information is visible to others on Discord.
page.help.20: Displays a VRCNext overlay inside your VR headset. Access your friends list, notifications, and quick actions without taking off your headset or switching windows.
page.help.21:
An automatic invite system. Add friends to the list and configure for each one which of your statuses allows them to auto-receive an invite when they send a Request Invite in VRChat.

Active (green), Ask Me (orange), and Do Not Disturb (red) can each be toggled per friend independently.
page.help.22:
Real-time in-game translation using AI. Translates chat messages and text from other players into your language as they appear.

Requirement: OSC must be enabled in VRChat under Options → OSC. An API key may be required depending on your configuration.
page.help.23: Automatically joins a VRChat event instance the moment it becomes available. Configure your target event and VRCNext will monitor it and join as soon as the instance opens.
page.help.24:
Adjust your avatar's scale in real-time using VRChat's OSC system. Use the slider or enter a precise value to change your height in-game.

Requirement: OSC must be enabled in VRChat under Options → OSC.
page.help.25:
Visual automation editor for VRChat. Build flows by snapping blocks together: pick a Trigger (every 30 seconds, when someone joins your instance, when someone invites you, at a specific time, when your status changes, and more), then drop in conditions and actions to react.

Actions can set your status, set your bio, send invites, request invites, reply to invites, and push notifications. Conditions check things like friend status, current world, who triggered the event, and time of day.

Flows save automatically and run in the background while VRCNext is open. Limits keep things safe: max 4 flows, 16 triggers across all flows, and 10 actions per flow.
page.help.26:
Take in-VR photos and GIFs in any SteamVR game not just VRChat.

How to use:
1. Connect FrameShot here, then put on your headset and start any VR game.
2. Bring both hands close together and hold the Frame keybind on both controllers (defaults to Grip).
3. Pull your hands apart. A light-blue frame appears between your hands and shows exactly what will be captured.
4. Release the right keybind to take the photo. Release the left keybind to cancel.

GIF recording (optional):
- Assign a Record keybind to one or both controllers in the Frame Keybind card.
- While framing, also hold the Record keybind. The frame turns red, its size locks, and it follows your head.
- Release the Record keybind to save the GIF. Max 8 seconds at 10 FPS, capped at 512x512 px.

Photos and GIFs are saved to Pictures/VRCN/FrameShots/ with date and time as the filename. The Activation Radius slider controls how close your hands must be to start framing. The Sound Output card lets you pick which audio device the start/shot/record sounds play through.
page.help.27:
Switches your VRChat status automatically on a schedule. Create rules with a time window and the status they should apply, and VRCNext sets it for you while it is running.

Each rule has a start and end time, the weekdays it runs on (no selection means every day), and one of the four statuses: Join Me, Online, Ask Me or Do Not Disturb. Optionally it can also set your status message.

Only While in Game limits a rule to times when VRChat is actually running. Restore Previous Status puts your old status back once the window ends. If several rules match at the same time, the one with the highest priority wins. An end time that is not after the start time means the window crosses midnight.

Rules are checked every 30 seconds while VRCNext is open. The switch next to each rule disables it without deleting it, and the switch at the top disables the whole schedule.
page.help.28:
Rotates your SteamVR playspace while in VR, similar to Space Turn in OVR Advanced Settings. Hold the configured controller button and twist your hand around the vertical axis. The world turns with your hand and pivots around your headset, so you stay in place.

Requires SteamVR to be running. Turn Multiplier scales how far the world rotates per degree of hand rotation. Comfort Mode rotates in fixed steps instead of smoothly. Reset returns the playspace to its original position. Space Turn and Space Flight share the same playspace, so they can be used together.
page.help.29:
Shows the top 200 people you have met most often in VRChat, friends and strangers alike, arranged in rings with your most frequent meets in the center. Bigger circle = more meets.

Click a person (or search for them) to expand the worlds you met them in. The world where you met them most often is shown biggest. Data comes from your local First Meet and Meet Again timeline events.
settings.accounts.title: Accounts
settings.accounts.desc: Manage your VRChat accounts. The primary account uses the main database, secondary accounts each get their own database. Credentials are stored locally and encrypted.
settings.accounts.warning.title: Experimental Feature
settings.accounts.warning.body: Switching Accounts is an experimental feature. It creates a separate database for each secondary account so the main database is not overloaded with data. Things might not work correctly on secondary accounts, expect bugs here and there. Secondary accounts do not get auto-backups, only your main account does. Some settings might not work as intended. Be warned.
settings.accounts.switch_confirm:
You want to switch the account to {name}?

Switching Account will cause the app to restart to load everything properly.
settings.accounts.switch_in_progress: Account switch in progress, action rejected
settings.accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Click "Add Account" to log in.
settings.accounts.remove_confirm: Remove {name} from the list? Its database file stays on disk and can be re-linked by adding the same account again.
settings.accounts.add_error_invalid_user: Invalid VRChat user ID returned by API
export.desc.worlds: Here's your worlds export. Your own worlds and your favorite worlds, in CSV format (Row: World ID, Name).
export.desc.groups: Here's your groups export. The groups you're in, in CSV format (Row: Group ID, Name).
export.desc.avatars: Here's your avatars export. Your own avatars and your favorite avatars, in CSV format (Row: Avatar ID, Name).
export.desc.friends: Here's your friends export. Your friends and your favorite friends, in CSV format (Row: User ID, Name).
import.desc.worlds: Assign each group from the file to one of your favorite world groups. Groups left on Skip are not imported. Supported files: CSV, JSON and TXT. IDs are detected automatically.
import.desc.avatars: Assign each group from the file to one of your favorite avatar groups. Groups left on Skip are not imported. Supported files: CSV, JSON and TXT. IDs are detected automatically.
import.empty: No worlds or avatars found in this file
import.nothing_selected: Select at least one target group

log_viewer.search: Search message, category, or stack trace
log_viewer.no_entries: No entries match the current filters
log_viewer.no_entries_description: Adjust levels, category, or search text.
log_viewer.no_files_description: Start VRChat once and refresh after output_log_*.txt appears.
log_viewer.error_load_entries: Failed to load VRChat log entries.
msg_tpl.title: Message Templates
msg_tpl.desc: The canned messages VRChat offers when you invite someone, request an invite, or reply to either. Editing a slot puts it on a 60 minute cooldown.
msg_tpl.cooldown_error: Slot is on cooldown for {minutes} more minutes
vrc_config.title: VRChat Config
vrc_config.desc: Edit VRChat's config.json directly. Changes are written to VRChat's own data folder.
vrc_config.prints_desc: Automatically save prints that players drop in your instance. VRCNext downloads each print once and stores it in the folder below.

action_flow.action.set_feature_tooltip: Turns a VRCNext feature on or off. true starts it, false stops it. Does nothing when the feature is already in that state.
action_flow.osc.no_params: (connect the OSC Tool, or type the parameter name yourself)
action_flow.osc.tooltip: Sends an OSC value to VRChat. A plain name is sent as an avatar parameter, a path starting with / is sent as is, so addresses like /input/Jump or /chatbox/typing work too. Requires the OSC Tool to be connected.

action_flow.block.if_tooltip: If the condition is true, run the do branch.
action_flow.block.wait_for_tooltip: Runs the branch after the given number of seconds. Blocks below this one keep running right away. Only one wait per block can be pending at a time.
action_flow.block.wait_until_tooltip: Checks the condition every second and runs the branch once it matches the attached true/false block. Gives up after 30 minutes. Blocks below this one keep running right away.
action_flow.block.cooldown_tooltip: Runs the branch right away, then blocks it for the given number of seconds. Use it to stop a trigger that fires often from spamming an action.
action_flow.block.cooldown_else_tooltip: Like cooldown, but the else branch runs while the cooldown is still active.
action_flow.log.wait_busy: wait skipped: this block is already waiting
action_flow.log.wait_until_started: waiting until the condition becomes true
action_flow.log.wait_timeout: wait until gave up: condition stayed false
action_flow.trigger.every_second_tooltip: Runs once per second. Works only with VRCN Actions and Logic blocks, does not work with VRC Actions or Webhook Actions (those are skipped).

action_flow.triggering_user_tooltip: The user that caused the current trigger to fire.
action_flow.time.between_tooltip: True while the current time is between the two times. Handles ranges that cross midnight.
action_flow.friend.is_favorite_tooltip: True when the user is in this favorite friend group. Works with both VRChat groups and VRCNext local groups.
action_flow.friend.invite_from_tooltip: True inside a "when someone invites me" trigger if the inviter matches this friend.
action_flow.friend.invite_request_from_t: True inside a "when someone requests an invite from me" trigger if the requester matches this friend.
action_flow.world_block.in_same_instance: is in same instance as me
action_flow.avatar_block.my_current_tool: Returns the ID of the avatar I am currently wearing.

action_flow.avatar_block.is_my_current_t: True if the given avatar ID matches my currently worn avatar.
action_flow.block.number_tooltip: A numeric literal — use on the right side of comparisons like "user count > 10".
action_flow.instance_block.user_count_to: Number of users currently in my instance (includes me).
action_flow.instance_block.my_type_toolt: Returns the instance type I am currently in (e.g., public, friends, invite_plus, group-plus).
action_flow.instance_block.type_literal_: A literal instance type — use on the right side of "= my instance type" to compare.
action_flow.action.set_status_tooltip: Sets your VRChat status (and status text if non-empty). Empty text keeps the existing status text.
action_flow.action.send_webhook_tooltip: Sends your text to a Discord webhook. Useful for long term logging instead of a temporary notification.
action_flow.action.send_webhook_value_to: Sends the value of the attached Get Info block to a Discord webhook.
action_flow.action.send_advanced_webhook: Sends your own text followed by the value of the attached Get Info block to a Discord webhook.
action_flow.log.webhook_missing_text: webhook skipped: missing or invalid webhook url
action_flow.trigger.friend_joins_instanc: when a friend joins an instance
action_flow.action.send_own_instance_inf: Sends your current instance (world image, name, type, player count) to a Discord webhook. Uses cached data, no VRChat request.
action_flow.action.send_own_advanced_ins: send own advanced instance info to
Like send own instance info, plus the player list. Uses cached data, no VRChat request.
action_flow.action.send_friend_instance_: Sends a friend instance info to a Discord webhook. Keep friend on (any friend) to use the friend from a "when a friend joins an instance" trigger.
action_flow.log.webhook_missing: instance info skipped: missing or invalid webhook url
action_flow.log.no_own_instance: instance info skipped: not currently in an instance
action_flow.log.no_friend_instance: friend instance info skipped: no friend in an instance (use inside a "when a friend joins an instance" trigger, or pick a friend)
action_flow.action.answer_invite_tooltip: Send a chat message back to the user who invited me. Use inside a "when someone invites me" trigger.
action_flow.action.answer_invite_request: Send a chat message back to the user who requested an invite. Use inside a "when someone requests an invite" trigger.
action_flow.log.no_trigger: no Trigger block found at root
action_flow.log.over_action_limit: over action limit ({count}/{limit}). Flow disabled until trimmed.
action_flow.log.over_trigger_limit: over global trigger limit ({count}/{limit}). All triggers disabled until trimmed.
action_flow.log.reply_skipped: {action} skipped: no triggering user (use inside a "when someone invites me" or "requests invite" trigger)

action_flow.info.bundle_list_tooltip: Collects several Get Info blocks into one message. Each entry becomes its own line. Plug it into a send notification or send to webhook block.
action_flow.info.text_tooltip: A piece of text you type yourself. Use it to label an entry in a bundled message list.
action_flow.info.join_text_tooltip: Glues two values into one line of text. A space is added between them unless the left side already ends with one.

action_flow.friend_info.presence_tooltip: Whether the picked friend is In Game, Active on Website or Offline.
action_flow.friend_info.icon_tooltip: Uses the friend's profile picture as the image of the message. Works in send notification and send to webhook, and shows up in the in-app card, the system tray notification, the VR overlay and the Discord webhook.

action_flow.info.heart_rate_tooltip: Current heart rate in BPM from the HypeRate connection of the Custom Chatbox. 0 when no data is available. Enable "Allow Action Flow using Heart Rate" in the Custom Chatbox to use it while the chatbox is off.
settings.decorations.title: VRC+ Decorations
settings.decorations.optimize.label: Optimize VRC+ Usage
settings.decorations.optimize.desc: Shows animated decorations as static images in friend lists and cards to greatly reduce memory and GPU usage. Animations still play in profile modals and on your own profile.
settings.decorations.icon_frames_desc: When enabled all profile icons including your own will be round instead of square, and the profile frame decoration is shown on every player that has one.
settings.decorations.nameplate_desc: When enabled, a player's VRC+ nameplate decoration is shown behind their entry in the friends sidebar and other places they appear.
settings.decorations.profile_effect_desc: When enabled, a player's VRC+ profile effect is shown as a frame over the banner in their profile modal.
settings.decorations.profile_background_: When enabled, VRCN will show your and your friends VRChat Background they have set on their profile.
settings.decorations.profile_theme_desc: When enabled, a player's VRC+ profile theme colours are applied to their profile modal. The button colour also tints the modal itself, about 25% darker.
settings.decorations.theme_contrast_desc: When enabled, text and icons of a VRC+ profile theme are darkened or lightened just enough to stay readable on the theme's own background. Turn this off to show the raw theme colours.
profiles.theme.title: Profile Theme
profiles.theme.name: Name
settings.decorations.transparent_cards_d: When enabled, the content cards, tab bar and buttons inside profile modals become 50% transparent so the profile background image stays visible behind them.

settings.decorations.square_frames_desc: When enabled, every profile without an icon frame decoration stays a square image. Only profiles that have a decoration get a round image.
settings.decorations.on_dashboard_desc: When enabled, VRC+ decorations are also shown on the Dashboard, for example in the Friends Location (Small) section.
